citation.title: Consequences on islet and incretin hormone responses to dinner by omission of lunch in healthy men

reported.what: suprabasal AUC of glucose after dinner, total 0-300 min, breakfast and lunch vs breakfast only (mean +/- SEM, n=12, mmol/L min)
suprabasal AUC of C-peptide after dinner, late 30-300 min (mean +/- SEM, n=12, nmol/L min)
suprabasal AUCs of insulin, glucagon, GIP and GLP-1 after dinner, early/late/total, two arms (mean +/- SEM, n=12)

detail: Every number the paper prints in text or tables is a single-arm suprabasal AUC (units such as mmol/L min, not in the unit table) or a derived index; the time courses exist only in Figure 1 and no ratio or difference of the two arms is printed.
